$comment: Shared default settings for all Luma editor extensions. Each extension maps these canonical keys to its native configuration format. A setting carries a 'vscode' object iff it is surfaced in VS Code's contributes.configuration (generators emit it into vscode/package.json). The 'generated' flag (default true) controls whether a setting is emitted to the editor constant files (config.ts/rs). See extensions/shared/download-spec.md for the download protocol and extensions/shared/error-handling.md for the error severity contract.

lsp.path.description: Absolute path to the luma_lsp binary. If empty, the extension downloads it automatically or searches PATH.

vscode.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `luma_lsp` binary. If empty, the extension downloads it automatically or searches `PATH`. Supports `${workspaceFolder}` and `${workspaceFolder:name}` variables.

lsp.autoUpdate.description: Automatically check for language server updates on extension activation.

vscode.markdownDescription: Automatically check for language server updates on activation.

lsp.enabled.description: Enable or disable the Luma language server integration.

lsp.trace.description: Trace level for language server communication. 'messages' logs request/response summaries; 'verbose' logs full payloads.

interpreter.path.description: Absolute path to the luma interpreter binary. If empty, the extension searches PATH.

vscode.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `luma` interpreter binary. If empty, the extension searches `PATH`. Supports `${workspaceFolder}` and `${workspaceFolder:name}` variables.

dap.path.description: Absolute path to the luma_dap debug adapter binary. If empty, the extension searches PATH.

vscode.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `luma_dap` debug adapter binary. If empty, the extension searches `PATH`. Supports `${workspaceFolder}` and `${workspaceFolder:name}` variables.

dap.enabled.description: Enable or disable the Luma debug adapter integration.

diagnostics.onSave.description: Only report linter warnings on save (not while typing). Syntax and type errors are always reported immediately.

vscode.markdownDescription: When enabled, only report linter warnings on save (not while typing). Syntax and type errors are always reported immediately.

diagnostics.maxFileSize.description: Maximum file size in bytes for which analysis is performed. Files exceeding this limit are skipped to avoid performance issues.

inlayHints.enabled.description: Show inferred type annotations as inlay hints in the editor.

vscode.markdownDescription: Show inferred type annotations as inlay hints.

codeLens.enabled.description: Show reference counts above functions and types as code lenses.

vscode.markdownDescription: Show reference counts above functions and types.

autoDownload.enabled.description: Automatically download pre-built binaries (luma_lsp, luma_dap) when not found locally.
autoDownload.enabled.$comment: Schema-only setting. Per-editor defaults are in auto_download.enabled below.

autoDownload.version.description: Version tag to download. Use 'latest' for the most recent release, or a specific tag like 'v0.5.0'.

playground.enabled.description: Enable the Luma playground for interactive code execution.

vscode.markdownDescription: Enable the Luma Playground for interactive code execution.

playground.timeout.description: Maximum execution time in milliseconds for playground snippets.

vscode.markdownDescription: Maximum execution time (in milliseconds) for playground snippets.

playground.maxOutputSize.description: Maximum output buffer size in bytes for playground snippets.

vscode.markdownDescription: Maximum output buffer size (in bytes) for playground snippets.

auto_download.$comment: Per-editor auto-download defaults. The download version is a single setting (autoDownload.version above), not an editor-specific default, so it lives there only.

enabled.$comment: VS Code and Zed auto-download by default.
